primary_hypothesis: H1: A history-conditioned transformer RL2 policy trained only on action_scale and action_noise achieves a positive adaptation gap on unseen action_latency: G_i = mean_return_adaptive_i - mean_return_no_history_i > 0 across independent training seeds i.
secondary_question: Does the sequence policy provide better control performance than an independently trained reactive robust baseline: D_i = mean_return_transformer_adaptive_i - mean_return_reactive_i?

validation_faults.notes: Derived strictly from training mechanisms with unseen parameter ranges. Never includes test faults.

predetermined_decision_rules.CASE_A: mean G > 0 and 95% seed-level bootstrap CI excludes 0 on positive side -> SUPPORTED POSITIVE ADAPTATION
predetermined_decision_rules.CASE_B: 95% seed-level bootstrap CI includes 0 -> ADAPTATION NOT ESTABLISHED
predetermined_decision_rules.CASE_C: mean G < 0 and 95% seed-level bootstrap CI excludes 0 on negative side -> NEGATIVE HISTORY EFFECT
predetermined_decision_rules.CASE_D: large heterogeneous seed effects with inconsistent signs across seeds -> SEED-SENSITIVE / UNSTABLE
